The Problem

Premium products need premium positioning

Club-level sales are underserved. Most marketing targets individual consumers, but the real volume comes from clubs, schools, and facilities buying in bulk.

Disconnected from construction. When new courts are built or resurfaced, equipment purchasing follows. If you're not connected to the builder, you miss the sale.

Brand dilution. Competing on price with online retailers destroys the premium positioning that drives club and facility partnerships.

FAQ

How do you connect tennis equipment brands with court projects?

Through our contractor network, we identify new tennis court construction and resurfacing projects and connect equipment brands during the facility outfitting phase.

Can you help reach tennis clubs and facilities?

Yes. We create marketing strategies that target club managers, facility directors, and tennis program operators who make equipment purchasing decisions.

What's different about marketing tennis equipment vs. other sports?

Tennis has an established premium market with higher per-customer value. We focus on positioning your brand for club-level and facility-level sales, not just retail.
